title: Google voice redesign merges AI Mode, Search Live, & Song lookup on Android
summary: This big revamp takes after Google Lens’s Search, Translate, Live, and Create switcher by adding a toolbar at the bottom of the screen that lets you go between Search, AI Mode, Search Live, and Song Search.
